subject.title: fix(memory): hide QMD transport metadata from recalled content

question: Should this PR land as a forward-only QMD adapter fix while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/106937 remains open for historical recall handling, or must a QMD-owned persisted-state repair ship in the same change?
rationale: Both directions are technically viable, but only the memory-state owners can choose whether continued contamination of existing recall records is an acceptable upgrade boundary.

options.title: Merge forward fix and retain follow-up
options.body: Land the proven adapter cleanup now and keep the canonical issue open until a QMD-owned doctor or rebuild policy addresses historical recalls.

options.title: Require repair before merge
options.body: Hold this PR until it includes a narrowly scoped QMD-owned migration or rebuild path with upgrade proof.

options.title: Accept no historical repair
options.body: Land the adapter change and explicitly decide that existing recall records age out naturally without migration.

recommendation.title: Merge forward fix and retain follow-up
recommendation.body: Land the proven adapter cleanup now and keep the canonical issue open until a QMD-owned doctor or rebuild policy addresses historical recalls.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the original QMD manager implementation and result-mapping boundary.
